Reference data · exceptions · auditability

SSI validation, made operational.

A deterministic Python and SQLite system that turns synthetic Standard Settlement Instructions into validated records, prioritized exceptions, controlled maker-checker decisions and reproducible KPI outputs.

View source on GitHub ↗ Inspect KPI output
Synthetic data only.
No real bank, client, custodian, settlement account or production-system data is used. Severity and prioritization are project conventions.

From raw data to action

The pipeline separates validation, exception creation, workflow, audit and reporting so every stage remains testable and inspectable.

01

Generate synthetic SSI and controlled reference tables

02

Run schema, reference, temporal and control rules

03

Create severity-classified operational exceptions

04

Apply maker-checker workflow and audit events

05

Persist SQLite and publish KPI-ready CSV outputs

15 configurable rules

Rule identifiers, descriptions, severity mapping, thresholds, workflow states and the active-instruction business key are centralized in configuration.

SSI-001Mandatory fieldsRequired values must be present.
SSI-002Duplicate SSI IDFlags every physical row sharing an identifier.
SSI-003Active conflictOne active instruction per configured business key.
SSI-004Supported currencyChecks the controlled currency list.
SSI-005Account formatValidates the synthetic account regex.
SSI-006–007Method and sourceControlled settlement methods and channels.
SSI-008–010Temporal controlsDate ordering, staleness and expiry.
SSI-011Currency / countryValidates permitted reference relationships.
SSI-012–013Maker / checkerCompleteness and segregation of duties.
SSI-014Workflow statusAllowed-state validation.
SSI-015Market / countryControlled market-country relationships.
CONFIGCentral policy layerNo scattered thresholds or transition lists.

Controls you can inspect

The repository includes executable code, sample data, SQL queries, tests and concise documentation for interview-ready review.

Maker-checker

Self-approval and invalid transitions are rejected before state changes.

Exception queue

Filterable by severity, status, client, market, currency, rule, age and assignee.

Structured audit

Machine-readable old and new state stored with actor, time and reason.

Reconciliation

CSV outputs, SQLite tables and KPI arithmetic are checked end to end.

Portfolio simulation only. Built with Python 3.11+, Pandas, NumPy, SQLite, SQL and pytest.
